title: fix(cloud-connection)!: install-local cloud branch refuses every register the engine refuses; only a fault stays lenient (#31478)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XTVkGrf2CjQTF79hBERgqiJ)_

domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5ktJb5rQ5n2GUXSQMR

Fixes #31478

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — a cloud-branch install that answered success (`hotLoaded: false`) for a register the engine refused is now refused 422; one contract-review-tier review owed before the queue
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` 的云端分支,凡是注册时引擎抛出自带 4xx 状态的拒绝,一律回 `422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED`,不写安装记录,和内联分支一致。卡片列的几类全部覆盖:默认记录页冲突、默认页放错位置、对象归属冲突、产物内对象重名、依赖共享命名空间下的对象重名、未声明的选项列表、绑定动作的目标对象不存在。#31392 的三类同名冲突也由同一条规则接住。
- 为什么改:以前这些都走宽容路径,写安装记录,回 200 和 `hotLoaded: false`,声称“下次重启加载”。在 main 上实测,重启时同一条拒绝再次触发,包根本加载不了。
- 宽容路径的去留(卡片要求一次性决定):只留给“没有声明 4xx 的注册失败”,也就是运行时自己的故障(未声明状态的抛错或声明 5xx)。这一类实测重启能治好,作为 CONTROL 钉住。
- 风险与回滚:`refusesNameHeldElsewhere` 和它的类名表被一个判定 `isDeclaredRegisterRefusal` 取代,按 `resolveThrownHttpError(err).declaredStatus` 读,不列任何类名或错误码。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/marketplace-install-local-register-refusal.test.ts src/marketplace-install-local-hot-loaded.test.ts`,预期全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, the cloud-fetched branch of `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` (a `packageId` + `versionId` body):

1. **One predicate decides the lenient path's fate.** `isDeclaredRegisterRefusal(err)` asks whether the register failure declares a 4xx status of its own (`resolveThrownHttpError(err).declaredStatus`, never a fallback this door supplies). Every refusal the registry's package door and the manifest service's seals raise declares `422` (ADR-0112). It replaces `refusesNameHeldElsewhere` and `NAME_HELD_ELSEWHERE_REFUSALS` (#31392), and the `NAMESPACE_CONFLICT_CODE` import goes with them.
2. **The catch asks it.** When it answers yes, the cloud branch answers `422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED` with `Package '<id>' cannot be installed: <the engine's sentence>`, before the ledger write and anything else this door writes.
3. **What stays lenient** is a register failure that declares no 4xx: an undeclared throw or a declared 5xx, which is the runtime's own fault and not a verdict on the package. It keeps #22695's answer (`200`, `hotLoaded: false`, `hotLoadError`).
4. **Doc comments.** The module header's install paragraph, the predicate's docblock (what was measured, which refusal a restart can heal and why that is not a reason to ledger it) and the catch comments.

What does not change:
- The inline branch.
- Step 1f's `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` for a namespace a writable base holds still answers first.
- Under `OS_METADATA_COLLISION=warn`, the namespace gate warns and throws nothing.
- No handbook page teaches the lenient path. `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` says a package the runtime recorded but could not load "loads when the runtime restarts", which is still true of the fault case.

## Which refusals a restart can heal (measured first, on main 7d7af560)

A throwaway probe, not committed, used the same real `ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin` harness. A second boot over the same ledger directory is the restart: the `kernel:ready` seals run before the plugin's rehydrate, as on a real boot.

- **Each listed class, installed fresh on the cloud branch:** `200`, `hotLoaded: false`, ledgered. At the restart the rehydrate logged the same refusal and loaded nothing (default record page, misplaced default page, unresolved picklist, unbound action target measured through a restart; the object-name classes meet the same owner at every boot).
- **A sealed-vocabulary refusal healed by another install.** A package binding an action to `dispatch_job` was installed before the package that owns `dispatch_job` (no declared dependency), and then the owner was installed. At the restart the outcome depended on the ledger's listing order:
  - binder `com.acme.routing` (listed after the owner): loaded;
  - binder `com.acme.adispatch` (listed before the owner): refused again, `rehydrate failed for com.acme.adispatch A top-level action is bound by objectName to an object that no loaded package registers`.

  The rehydrate sorts by declared `dependencies` only, and the reference this refusal names is one the package did not declare. Once declared, the pre-install dependency check refuses the install `422` up front instead. And once the owner is installed, installing the binder again succeeds at once with no restart (pinned below). So this is no reason to ledger it.
- **A register fault declaring no status:** ledgered, and the restart loads it (the CONTROL below).

## Design call (the four axes)

Two options were on the card: (A) extend #31392's code + name set with the listed classes, or (B) decide the lenient path once for every pre-write refusal. **Chosen: B**, by the status the throw declares.

- **Real need.** Every refusal measured above fails again at every boot, so `hotLoaded: false` / "loads at the next restart" was a false success for each. The only case a restart heals is a fault, and B keeps exactly that one lenient.
- **Long-term soundness.** A cannot cover the sealed-vocabulary refusals: they are plain `Error`s with `code: 'INVALID_METADATA'`, a code other refusals share (an action that fails `ActionSchema`, a field with no `type`). A would need either message parsing or a new brand in the engine, plus a list to keep in step with every refusal the engine gains. B reads the declaration ADR-0112 already requires of every refusal, so a refusal added later is refused here with no change.
- **Making AI mistakes harder.** A lenient `200` for a body the engine refused is the tolerance the axis warns against: an AI-written package with a typo'd picklist or `objectName` was reported installed. Under B it is refused loudly at install, with the engine's sentence naming the fix.
- **Startup-stage focus.** One predicate replaces one, with no new surface, gate or field. Abolishing the lenient path outright was weighed and not chosen: it would also refuse the one case a restart does heal, and the card scoped the change to refusals.

## Tests

`marketplace-install-local-register-refusal.test.ts` (new) uses the #31296 harness: a real `ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin`, booted. The holder is installed through the same door, and the cloud leg is a stubbed `fetch`.

- **Seven fresh installs, one per refusal:**
  - a default record page another package holds;
  - `isDefault: true` on a `home` page;
  - an object another package owns;
  - an object name two packages of one release artifact define;
  - an object the package it depends on owns;
  - a picklist no loaded package declares;
  - a bound action whose object no loaded package registers.

  Each answers 422 in the declared envelope with the engine's sentence. Nothing is registered, the ledger is exactly as before, and the holder still owns its object.
- **Two upgrades** (a registry refusal and a seal refusal): 422, and the installed version 1 is still registered and ledgered.
- **The remedy:** the bound-action install is refused, the owner is installed, and the same install then answers `200` with `hotLoaded: true`.
- **CONTROL:** a register throwing a plain `Error` keeps `200` with `hotLoaded: false`, `hotLoadError` and a ledger entry, and the restart loads the package.

The #31296 / #31392 / #25366 suites and `marketplace-install-local-hot-loaded.test.ts` are unchanged and green.

<details><summary>Red on main (the new file against the unfixed plugin, fix reverted in the tree)</summary>

```

× a fresh install of a default page that is not a record page is refused: …
× a fresh install of an object another package owns is refused: …
× a fresh install of an object name two packages of one artifact define is refused: …
× a fresh install of an object the package it depends on owns is refused: …
× a fresh install of a picklist no loaded package declares is refused: …
× a fresh install of a bound action whose object no loaded package registers is refused: …
× an upgrade to a default record page another package holds is refused: 422, the installed version still registered and ledgered
× an upgrade to a bound action whose object no loaded package registers is refused: …
× the remedy a bound action's refusal names: once the object's package is installed, the same install succeeds at once
AssertionError: {"success":true,"data":{"manifestId":"com.acme.routing",…,"hotLoaded":false,"hotLoadError":"Default record page conflict: page \"routing_job_detail\" of package \"com.acme.routing\" cannot be the default record page of object \"dispatch_job\": …"}}: expected 200 to be 422
AssertionError: {…"hotLoadError":"A picklist is named that no loaded package declares: field 'routing_visit.status' (package 'com.acme.routing') references picklist 'routing_visit_status'. …"}}: expected 200 to be 422
Tests  10 failed | 1 passed (11)
```
The one pass is the CONTROL.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (fix committed at c5e8a858, each restored)</summary>

Both were run through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`. The suites import the plugin from `src/` relatively, so no build applies.

1. The catch's `if (isDeclaredRegisterRefusal(err))` was replaced by `if (false as boolean)`, so no refusal is recognised. The ten new refusal cases go red, and so do the #31296, #31392 and #25366 pins, because the held names are now recognised by the same rule:
```
ablation-replace: ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 20affa167148 -> 42a56d5cb8a1
Tests  24 failed | 19 passed (43)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (20affa167148) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```
2. The predicate's body was replaced by `return true`, which abolishes the lenient path. The CONTROL and the #22695 lenient pin go red:
```
ablation-replace: ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob 20affa167148 -> 577f2d41d3a1
× a cloud-fetched manifest whose register throws answers 200 with hotLoaded: false and the register error as hotLoadError
× CONTROL — a register fault declaring no status keeps the lenient answer, and the restart heals it
Tests  2 failed | 13 passed (15)
ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (20affa167148) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```
</details>

## Verification

All checks ran on head `538d1389`: the fix, the tests and the changeset, merged once with `origin/main` at `dabef0f6`. Each exit code was captured before any pipe.

- **Full build**, `pnpm turbo run build --concurrency=2`, under the verify lock: VERDICT command-exit 0 (120 of 120 tasks).
- **Derived gate union**, `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 69 families, all run after the full build. 68 exited 0 on the first run. `check:type-check-debt` exited 3 (its prerequisite: the lock was held by the dogfood run) and exited 0 when re-run after the lock was released. `--ran` reports "69 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 69 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- **Facade gate**, `pnpm check:facade-delegation-only`: exit 0. This diff touches no facade file.
- **Package**: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection test`: Test Files 77 passed, Tests 1048 passed (exit 0). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection typecheck` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit`: exit 0.
- **Lint**: `eslint --no-inline-config` on the two touched `.ts` files: exit 0.
- **Full dogfood battery**, the `(narrowing)` arm, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` after the full build, under the verify lock: VERDICT command-exit 0. Test Files 440 passed / 3 skipped (443), Tests 3633 passed / 41 skipped (3674).
- **Main after the merge.** `origin/main` moved to `6ed533f6` while the checks ran. #31537 and #31529 touch `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, away from the register catch. `git merge-tree --write-tree HEAD origin/main` is clean, and this branch was not merged a second time.
- CI-only families (the Test Core shards, the type-check lanes, Build Docs) are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.

## Acceptance notes

- **The remaining lenient case,** with the restart that heals it: a register failure that declares no 4xx (an undeclared throw or a declared 5xx). The next restart of the runtime, or of a build that fixes the fault, registers the ledgered entry. That is pinned by the CONTROL.
- **Measured beside the card, not changed here.** A multi-package artifact whose second member is refused leaves the first member registered in the running kernel, unledgered, so it is gone at the restart. The manifest service registers an artifact's packages one by one. The inline branch measured the same (`422`, `com.acme.crm` registered, ledger empty). Withdrawing the earlier members is the manifest service's (`@objectstack/objectql`), outside this door, and is named in the report as a follow-up.
- **Old ledger entries.** An entry an earlier build ledgered this way is read at boot as before. This PR refuses new ones only.
- **Governed surface.** None. The diff is one source file, one new test file and one changeset.
